title: Geometric stalks commute with etale-to-pro-etale inverse image
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme, $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ the comparison geometric morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For every sheaf $\mathcal H$ of sets or abelian groups on the small etale site, there is a canonical isomorphism
$$(\nu_T^*\mathcal H)_{\bar t}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal H_{\bar t},$$
natural in $\mathcal H$. The left stalk is defined using pointed weakly etale neighbourhoods [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk], and the right stalk using pointed etale neighbourhoods [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. In the abelian case the isomorphism is additive. If $\mathcal H$ is a sheaf of left modules over a fixed ring $\Lambda$, where comparison inverse image on these modules means applying the set inverse image to the underlying sheaf and its addition, zero, negation and each scalar operation, it is $\Lambda$-linear; commutativity and finiteness of $\Lambda$ are not required.

proof.text: Define the pro-etale point by the lift functor U ↦ Hom_T(Spec Ω,U), enlarged by ULift to universe u+1. Its elements category is equivalent to the pointed weakly etale neighbourhood category of [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk], hence cofiltered and initially small. For a covering sieve choose a generating pro-etale covering family, base change it along the lift Spec Ω → U, and use joint surjectivity to choose a point of one member. That member is weakly etale over Spec Ω. Apply [lem-fix-weakly-etale-algclosed-section] and compose its section with the other pullback projection. The pullback equation proves that this is a lift into the original sieve. This is the fully proved private helper comparison_cover_lift and the explicit point comparisonPoint.

The inclusion toProEt is continuous, representably flat and cover preserving by [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]; cover preservation follows from etaleTopology_le_proetaleTopology and coverPreserving_changeProp. Its composite with the pro-etale lift functor is definitionally the ULift of the etale lift functor. Construct the explicit equivalence comparisonPointElements and apply Functor.Final.colimIso to identify the pro-etale neighbourhood colimit with this point fibre. Its coprojection formula is Final.ι_colimitIso_hom. The analogous ULift equivalence removes the universe enlargement on the etale side, again with the same coprojection formula.

Apply [lem-cbc-site-point-comap-germ] to this point and toProEt. Compose the neighbourhood-colimit isomorphism, uniqueness of left adjoints for the specified comparison adjunction and the abstract sheaf pullback adjunction, the inverse of sheafFiberComapIso, and the etale ULift isomorphism. Germ naturality moves the left-adjoint comparison before the germ. Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies its composite with the specified unit. The unit-germ formula of the cited lemma followed by its inverse identity and the ULift coprojection formula proves exactly the normalization in HasCanonicalProEtaleStalkComparison. All factors are natural isomorphisms, so naturality needs no separate elementwise argument.

The private comparison_generic proof works for every coefficient category with products in universe u+1 and colimits in universes u and u+1. Specialize it to Type (u+1), AddCommGrpCat and ModuleCat Λ. The supplied adjunctions are proEtaleSiteComparison and ProEtale.comparisonAdjunction. The latter components are isomorphisms in their coefficient categories, hence already additive or Λ-linear, for an arbitrary ring Λ. This is a categorical specialization, with no passage through underlying sets and no filtered-forgetful comparison required.
